subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should permanent Telegram forum-topic deletion require a dedicated disabled-by-default capability instead of inheriting the default-enabled create/edit action model?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing behavior but cannot determine the intended operator authorization for an irreversible action or whether the additional configuration surface is acceptable.

options.title: Dedicated delete opt-in
options.body: Add close/reopen under topic management and expose permanent deletion only through a separate disabled-by-default action flag.

options.title: Shared topic authorization
options.body: Authorize create, edit, close, reopen, and delete through the same topic-management action model.

options.title: Defer permanent deletion
options.body: Implement close/reopen while leaving delete unsupported until a separate destructive-action design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Dedicated delete opt-in
recommendation.body: Add close/reopen under topic management and expose permanent deletion only through a separate disabled-by-default action flag.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent broad refactor owns the current action-contract shape, making this the strongest available routing signal for the product/API decision.
